messages.author: 17f8070912132195
messages.subject: INLA warning
parts:
Dear INLA-group,


My model output displayed the following warning:


*** Warning *** Skewness correction for transf.hyperpar[76] is too high/low: gmean = 0.15, corr= (0.17,0.13). This has been corrected for, but is usually a sign of an ill-defined model and/or issues with the fit.


My model includes 6 hurdle models, and the 76th hyperparameter represents the log(Stdev) for a SPDE belonging to the 6th group. Could you please advise whether this issue needs to be addressed, and if so, how can I rectify it?


Thanks,

Ruby

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA warning
parts:
Its getting technical...normally its nothing to worry about. with your involved
model I would just do a rerun to be sure

r <- inla(...)
r <- inla.rerun(r)
